name: Starlink Group 15-24
slot_a_text: SpaceX's 107th launch of the year, 726th all time. 57th from SLC-4E this year, 4 days after the last one. The 212th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Falcon 9 is on a 331 flight success streak.
slot_b_text: The soot on a landed Falcon 9 is rarely cleaned off fully, giving flight-proven boosters a distinct dirty look.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
